meta.name: dev-ralplan
meta.description: Multi-perspective consensus planning with Planner/Architect/Critic loop. Use when high-stakes decisions need RALPLAN-DR structured deliberation (auth, migrations, public APIs, irreversible changes). Pairs with @compass-planner + @apex-architect + @raven-critic.

copy.tagline: 用多视角共识规划高风险的架构决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在团队中结构化地讨论和决策重大技术变更。
copy.tagline_en: Structure high-stakes architecture decisions with multi-perspective consensus planning.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need structured deliberation for critical technical decisions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会启动一个由规划师、架构师和评论家角色组成的多人共识规划流程，生成带有原则、决策驱动因素、可行选项和架构决策记录的计划。
howto.when: 当需要多视角共识来制定高风险或不可逆的决策（如身份验证、数据迁移、破坏性变更）时触发。你也可以直接说“ralplan”、“consensus”等关键词来激活。

say.text: 我们来对认证方案做一次共识规划。
用ralplan对这次数据迁移做规划。
启动共识模式，讨论API变更。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude initiates a multi-perspective consensus planning loop with Planner, Architect, and Critic roles, producing a plan with principles, decision drivers, viable options, and an Architecture Decision Record.
howto.when_en: Triggered when multi-perspective consensus is needed for high-stakes or irreversible decisions (e.g., auth, data migrations, breaking changes). You can also activate it by saying "ralplan", "consensus", etc.

say_en.text: Let's do a consensus plan for the authentication scheme.
Use ralplan to plan this data migration.
Start consensus mode to discuss API changes.
